# yyjson 0.13.0 (vendored)

`yyjson.c`, `yyjson.h` and `LICENSE` (MIT) are unmodified copies from
<https://github.com/ibireme/yyjson>, tag `0.13.0` (commit
`6447536015f3d600f3d65323b10976103b337ca7`), release archive
`yyjson-0.13.0.tar.gz` with SHA-256
`34e0f62a2bc11ab20d601e8ca1cc2b2079503aa45119a19133d89d19b94a0fae`.

The library compiles it into `libqucelerate-ai-gateway` with hidden symbols, so it is
not part of the C ABI and does not clash with another copy in the program.
